description: This C# source file implements a generic LogViewAdaptor class for handling log storage with batching, e-tags, and notification processing within Orleans's event sourcing framework. It manages log retrieval, updates, consistency, and distributed notifications for log entries.

classes.name: LogViewAdaptor<TLogView, TLogEntry>
classes.description: A generic adaptor for log views that manages batching, ETags, and notification processing, extending PrimaryBasedLogViewAdaptor.

classes.name: UpdateLogStorageFailed
classes.description: Exception class representing failures to write the log to storage.

classes.name: ReadFromLogStorageFailed
classes.description: Exception class representing failures to read the log from storage.

classes.name: UpdateNotificationMessage
classes.description: Represents a notification message containing log updates, version, origin, and ETag.

methods.description: Returns the last confirmed log view.

methods.description: Returns the version of the last confirmed log.

methods.description: Initializes the confirmed view and metadata.

methods.description: Updates the confirmed view from the global log.

methods.description: Retrieves a segment of log entries between specified versions.

methods.description: Creates a new submission entry for a log entry.

methods.description: Reads the log state asynchronously from storage.

methods.name: Merge

methods.description: Handles incoming notifications and adds them to queue.

methods.name: ProcessNotifications
